name: Ajax First-Timers 2022

venue.name: [Ajax Community Centre - HMS Community Hall](https://facilities.ajax.ca/Home/Detail?Id=db52c417-b7aa-40fe-8939-61304512694f)
venue.details: The HMS Community Hall is on the main floor of the community centre

information:
This is a competition in a series with [Ajax NxNxN 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AjaxNNN2022). You will only be able to register for *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

This competition is targeted towards new competitors, but you do not have to be a new competitor to register for this competition.

**Reminder:** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. We expect that registration will fill up fast, so please plan to be ready as soon as registration opens!
